new_construction_exemption.basis: Newly constructed multiple dwellings are exempt from the limits on periodic increases. The exemption lasts for the initial mortgage amortization period or 30 years after completion of construction, whichever is less. Completion of construction means issuance of the Certificate of Occupancy. If there is no initial mortgage financing, the exemption is 30 years. The landlord must apply to the Rent Control Board for certification.

unverifiable_exemptions: Newly constructed multiple dwellings certified exempt by the Rent Control Board, for the shorter of the initial mortgage amortization period or 30 years
Dwellings vacant for at least 18 months (or already vacant) and substantially rehabilitated at a cost above 50% of fair market value, exempt for 5 years on Board determination
Units rehabilitated under Federal/State Rental Rehabilitation Programs receiving Section 8 subsidies or Federal housing vouchers, during program tenure
Units under a landlord contract with a governmental agency that regulates rent and supersedes city authority
coverage.summary: Applies to all multiple dwellings in Newark, defined as any building with one or more apartments rented or offered for rent. Exempt: public housing; hotel or motel space rented day-to-day to transients; space rented for commercial use; certified new construction; substantially rehabilitated vacant dwellings, for 5 years; certain Section 8 rental rehabilitation units; and units under a governmental agency rent-regulation contract.
coverage.owner_conditions: The chapter defines an owner-occupied dwelling (four units or fewer, with the owner living in one), but owner-occupied dwellings are not in the list of exemptions. Their only special treatment is that no inspection fee is charged for owner-occupied units.

result.notes: Cleared other_conditions: annual registration, substantial code compliance and the certificate-of-habitability requirement are landlord-conduct preconditions, not coverage criteria. They are already described in the requirement text. Made the vacant-dwelling exemption more precise: the dwelling must have been vacant for at least 18 months (or already vacant), and rehabilitation must cost more than 50% of fair market value. Rewrote new_construction_exemption.basis so it no longer says the exemption is the 'shorter' of the two periods in a way that misplaced the Certificate of Occupancy reference. Rewrote the owner_conditions sentence; its meaning is unchanged. min_units is left null: the definition covers buildings with one or more apartments, so there is no meaningful threshold. requires_unknown_facts stays false because the rule covers all ordinary rental multiple dwellings, and the subsidy and contract exemptions are listed under unverifiable_exemptions.
